title: Aparupa
desc: Prof. Mukherjee's newlywed daughter lives apart from her husband working abroad. As she helps a friend in crisis, family misunderstandings arise, testing her relationships.

title: Shapath Nilam
desc: Sukanta is shattered when his wife, Minu, is raped on their honeymoon. Though his wife fails to recognise him after the incident, her twin sister, Debu, tries to find the culprit.

title: Sangharsha
desc: In a village divided by corruption and power struggles between a politician and a doctor, honest newcomer Shubhankar challenges the status quo.

title: Pabitra Papi
desc: To teach Bhola a lesson, Rajib marries his sister, deceives them out of their land, and has Bhola imprisoned. However, Bhola vows to seek justice and avenge the wrongs done to his family.

title: Rakto Nodir Dhara
desc: Jaga, an international terrorist, avoids a prison term of 21 years by killing multiple people involved in the case. However, the sons of his victims return to seek vengeance.
